question: Among people experiencing homelessness and serious mental illness, what are the effects of Housing First on criminal justice outcomes?
eligibility: Homeless or precariously housed people with mental illness.
Randomized and non-randomized comparative studies included by the review.
as_of_source: Review search cutoff: July 2018; set to the first day after the reported month.
source: Aubry et al. 2019, The impact of Housing First on criminal justice outcomes. PMID 30612450; PMCID PMC6659163. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6659163/
notes: All 5 included table records resolved to PubMed PMIDs.
